visual_review: Pale pearl-ivory head, socket, bands, butt and ivory wood; both flush haft strips retained. Original rear spike, two-rivet socket strap, four face facets, dark crossed channels and open lanyard hole coherent. Thin contained lit cheek contour/socket seam, one socket ring and pale repair cord preserved. Brown structural grip remains as in the source while the cord repair is ivory; class block specifies pale head and haft. Candidate only.
